info.title: Songfacts API
info.summary: The stories behind the songs and artists, delivered as Songfacts and Artistfacts JSON.
info.description:
Editorial stories behind songs and artists, written by human music experts since 1999,
returned as display-ready JSON. Send an artist and title (or a Songfacts ID) and the API
resolves it to one best match and returns its facts as HTML strings.

Use it for Now Playing enrichment, artist bio modules, editorial/CMS enrichment, radio and
playlist segments, and this-day-in-music features.

## Contract
- `POST` + `application/json` only. Field names are `snake_case`; unknown fields are rejected.
- **HTTP status is always `200`.** Read `meta.status` (`ok` / `fail`) and `meta.matched`.
- A no-match is not an error: `meta.status = "ok"`, `meta.matched = false`.
- Optional enrichment fields are omitted when unavailable (never `null`).
- Send `"debug": true` for matcher diagnostics (not a versioned contract).

## Authentication (HMAC-SHA256)
Every request carries `X-Client-Id`, `X-Timestamp`, `X-Nonce` and `X-Signature`.
The signature is the lowercase-hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with your shared secret, of:

```text
POST\n{path}\n{timestamp}\n{nonce}\n{sha256_hex(raw body bytes)}
```

- `path` is the URL path only, e.g. `/v5/songfacts` (no host, no trailing slash, no query).
- `timestamp` is Unix seconds, accepted within ±300 s; `nonce` is 16–128 chars of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, never reused.
- Hash the exact bytes you send. Server-to-server only; never ship the secret to a browser or app.

Full guide and runnable cURL / Node.js / Python / PHP signing samples:
https://github.com/Savage-Ventures-Github/songfacts-api-examples

## Access
Credentials are issued per client by Songfacts. Free trial accounts (500 calls) are available:
https://api.songfacts.com/#get-started

tags.description: Artist identity plus the artist's full facts.

post.summary: Get a song and its facts
post.description:
Resolve a song by `id`, or by `artist` + `title` (both required), and return its identity,
optional enrichments and paginated facts (HTML, keyed by fact ID).
`id` cannot be combined with `artist`/`title`; ID lookups never fall back to name matching.

200.description: Processed (match or no-match) or failed — inspect `meta`.

post.summary: Get an artist and their facts
post.description:
Resolve an artist by `id` or `artist` name and return identity plus paginated Artistfacts.
`title` is not accepted. A song's `song.artist.id` from `/v5/songfacts` can be used here directly.

200.description: Processed (match or no-match) or failed — inspect `meta`.

post.summary: Get one artist or song blurb
post.description:
Send `artist` for an artist blurb, or `artist` + `title` for a song blurb (falls back to the
artist blurb when the song has none). ID lookup and pagination fields are not supported.

200.description: Processed (match or no-match) or failed — inspect `meta`.

post.summary: Browse categories or list songs in a category
post.description:
`action: "list"` browses/searches categories (always paginated, no `showall`).
`action: "songs"` returns songs for one category by `category_id` or `category_slug`.

200.description: Processed (match or no-match) or failed — inspect `meta`.

post.summary: Music history by date, calendar category or timeline
post.description:
`action: "entries"` returns entries for a day (optionally narrowed by `month`/`year`).
`action: "categories"` and `action: "timeline"` browse/search, or return entries for one
category/timeline by ID or slug. Defaults: `limit` 20, `offset` 0.

200.description: Processed (match or no-match) or failed — inspect `meta`.

clientId.name: X-Client-Id
clientId.description:
Your lowercase slug client ID. Songfacts uses HMAC-SHA256 request signing; all four
headers (`X-Client-Id`, `X-Timestamp`, `X-Nonce`, `X-Signature`) are required on every request.
Canonical string (joined with `\n`, no trailing newline): `POST`, path, timestamp, nonce,
lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw body. Signature = lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(canonical, secret).
Guide: https://github.com/Savage-Ventures-Github/songfacts-api-examples/blob/main/docs/authentication.md

timestamp.name: X-Timestamp
timestamp.description: Unix epoch time in whole seconds, accepted within ±300 seconds of server time.

nonce.name: X-Nonce
nonce.description: 16–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, cryptographically random, fresh on every request.

signature.name: X-Signature
signature.description: Exactly 64 lowercase hex characters — HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical string keyed with your shared secret.

PublicId.description: Public numeric ID. Native integer or a clean integer string; `0` is invalid.

Limit.description: Page size. Values above 50 are silently clamped. `0` is invalid.

Offset.description: Zero-based offset. An out-of-range offset returns a valid empty page.

FactSort.description: Orders facts by fact ID before pagination.

Showall.description: Return the full set. Cannot be combined with `limit`/`offset`; may be restricted per client.

Debug.description: Adds a root `debug` diagnostics object to processed responses.

ArtistfactsRequest.description: Provide either `id` or `artist`. `title` is not accepted.

title.description: Optional. Requests a song blurb (falls back to the artist blurb).

type.description: Category type slug to narrow by, e.g. `written-by`.

sort.description: `relevance` is allowed only when `q` is present. `popularity` = linked-song count.

artist.description: Narrow to songs by this artist.

filter_featured_event.description: With both filters true, entries matching either flag are returned.

CalendarCategoriesRequest.description: Without `category_id`/`category_slug` this browses/searches categories (`q` allowed only then).

CalendarTimelineRequest.description: Without `timeline_id`/`timeline_slug` this browses/searches timelines (`q` allowed only then).

NoMatch.description: A completed lookup that found nothing. Not an error.

Error.description: Codes are the contract; there is intentionally no human-readable message.

BestCandidate.description: Closest below-threshold candidate on a name-based no-match. Never present on ID lookups.

DebugInfo.description: Diagnostics returned when `debug` is true. Not a versioned contract.

limit_clamped.description: Present only when the server clamped or defaulted the limit.

Facts.description: Omitted when `offset` is past the end of the set.

items.description:
Keyed by fact ID (integer serialized as a string). Values are HTML.
Sort keys as integers after parsing; JSON key order is not guaranteed.

url.description: Canonical Songfacts page; use for attribution.

BlurbMatch.description: Contains `artist` (artist mode) or `song` (song mode), each with a single `blurb`.

CalendarResult.description: Shape depends on `action` — browse arrays (`categories`/`timelines`), or a context object (`date`, `category`, `timeline`) plus `entries`.

items.190815: U2 recorded a new version of "One" for their 2023 album Songs Of Surrender. It debuted at the Super Bowl that year as part of the Walter Payton Man Of The Year presentation.

items.14682: On their 2003-2004 tour, Metallica started mixing up their setlists, a process they refined over the years.
